_doc: AgenticPlace iNFT mint deployment registry, read by /inft (inft_mint.js). The iNFT is the DeltaVerse ERC-7857 iNFT_7857, deployed via ~/DeltaVerse/deploy and SECONDED by the SCIEN·TIFIC first-light canary. Addresses are DETERMINISTIC (CREATE2 via Nick's factory) — identical on every chain, computed offline from salt+initCode, so they already equal the eventual mainnet address. Status is `create2_predicted_awaiting_overlord_signature`: the OVERLORD (bankon.eth) must sign the real deploy via ~/DeltaVerse/pages/deployer.html (an agent cannot sign mainnet). The mint path is the AgenticPlace hand-off: AgenticPlace owns the ERC-7857 mintAgent + IPFS payload pipeline (agent card + sealed key); /inft packages the archetype spec (incl. avatar) and hands off.

Scientific.name: Scientific
Scientific.role: first-light canary — seconds the iNFT deploy

_activation: OVERLORD signs deploy of Scientific (salt deltaverse.scientific.v1) then iNFT_7857 (salt deltaverse.inft.v1) via ~/DeltaVerse/pages/deployer.html with owner bankon.eth; CREATE2 → these exact addresses. Then set agenticplace.chainId + contracts.*.deployed=true (and mintMode 'direct' only if a simple-form mintable variant is used).
